title: Aakhri Gawah
description: Sarkari vakeel {{playerName}} ko ek bandh case ki file milti hai jisme witness box tak pahuncha hua ek gawah — aur likha hua hai ki uski maut 2019 mein ho chuki hai. Advocate Meera Deshmukh case re-open karna chahti hai. Investigation court records, gawahi aur insaaf ki limits par player-led rahegi; koi culprit, twist ya ending pehle se tay nahi.
